node.title: Re: how to extract original string from binary files?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [swapy345],

You would use the [doc://unpack] templates which correspond to the data types contained within the binary file, these are documented in [doc://pack]. Also, I'd recommend to [doc://open] the file with the "raw" layer to make sure no translations happen, e.g. open my $fh, '<:raw', 'filename' or die $!; (see also [doc://binmode]).

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
